title: Austin Rowing Club
specs: Rowing on Lady Bird Lake with 18 km of protected water
Hosts two regattas annually and informal races year-round
Learn to Row classes for people 18+
Guest rowers must be members in good standing of a rowing club outside 50-mile radius, have active USRowing membership, and be Safe Sport Compliant
Driver’s License, Passport, or Military ID required per watercraft rental
Group reservations for kayak/paddleboard rentals for 10 or more, pre-paid
Visiting crews can schedule practice visits December through April, limited to two simultaneous crews
includes: All boats and gear provided in learn to row classes
Life vest(s) and paddles included with kayak and paddleboard rentals
gap: Age minimum for kayak and paddleboard rentals not stated
blurb: Austin Rowing Club offers rowing classes for beginners and memberships for all skill levels. Members have access to coaching, facilities, and boats on Lady Bird Lake. The club hosts regattas and social events year-round.
extraNote: No cash or checks accepted; credit cards and contactless payments accepted · Cancellation deposit refundable only if notified 60 days prior; 25% refund if notified 30 days prior · Life vests required for all 13 and under; encouraged for 14 and older · 74 Trinity St., on the lower level of the Waller Creek Boathouse
